intent: 按 userData 字段查对象
signature: getObjectByUserDataProperty(key: string, value: any, opts?: { scope?: string }): Object3D[]

params.name: opts.scope
params.desc: 限定查找范围, 如 'A_6F' (floorName) 或 'A' (building)

code: const objs = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('renderType', 'CEILING'); console.log('found', objs.length, 'objects'); objs.slice(0, 3).forEach((o, i) => console.log(i, o.userData.sid, o.userData.renderType));
example: const wins = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('renderType', 'WINDOW'); const a6 = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('renderType', 'WINDOW', { scope: 'A_6F' }); const toilets = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('spaceType', 'TOILET');
guard: 返回数组, 记得取 [0] 或遍历
